recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓顆粒呈網狀，幾乎全是大小不一的脂肪空泡與基質，只有稀疏散在的細胞，缺乏造血細胞群與巨核細胞，符合再生不良性貧血的脂肪性低細胞骨髓。
features: Low-power view of a marrow particle composed mainly of fat vacuoles of varying size
Delicate stromal and capillary meshwork forming a lacy particle outline
Sparse scattered nucleated cells within the stroma; hematopoietic cells markedly reduced
No megakaryocytes and no dense cellular hematopoietic areas identified
Hemodiluted background of red cells with few leukocytes; detailed cytology limited at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate shows a particle composed almost entirely of fat vacuoles supported by a delicate stromal network. Hematopoietic cells are markedly decreased, and megakaryocytes are not identified. The surrounding smear is hemodilute with scant nucleated cells. Findings are consistent with a markedly hypocellular (fatty) marrow as seen in aplastic anemia; confirm on trephine biopsy and exclude hypocellular MDS or leukemia.

ddx.vs: Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes or myeloid cells, ring sideroblasts or increased CD34-positive cells, and often clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Elderly marrow is fattier but still retains trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes appropriate for age, without peripheral pancytopenia.
Serous fat atrophy shows gelatinous pink extracellular material with hypocellularity rather than clean fat vacuoles.
